name: Parametric Minecraft Creeper - Now With Dualstrusion!

captions.detailed: A low-poly, pixelated 3D model of a Minecraft Creeper lying on its side. It features a blocky head, a rectangular body, and two blocky leg sections at the base. The model is composed entirely of flat, orthogonal rectangular prisms, capturing the characteristic blocky aesthetic of the game.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, low-poly Minecraft Creeper model designed for 3D printing. Include parameters to scale the model using a custom pixel size, and a 'part' selection parameter to generate either the full body, a body prepared for dual-extrusion, or just the face details.
captions.factory: The model is built using conditional logic based on the 'part' parameter ('first', 'second', 'third'). It uses the 'cube' primitive to construct the blocky head, body, and legs. The face features (eyes and mouth) are cut out of the head using the 'difference' operator for the body parts, or isolated as positive 'cube' elements for the face-only part. The entire assembly is scaled by 'pixel_size', rotated 90 degrees on the Y-axis, and translated so it lies flat on its side.
